posts.author: blane3542
posts.body: Hey so I downloaded RPG Maker VX Ace, and I can't find my product key. Is there any way I can find it?

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
the product key is the invoice number of your purchase
if you don't have the invoice anymore you can contact sales support to have it resend.
if that is the trial asking for it, and it refuses to skip, then you need to activate TLS 1.2 or 1.3 or so in the Windows internet protocols
